protocol.ground_truth_separation: Truth below is read only by the harness that injects faults and scores reports afterwards; the agent receives a constant neutral alert (service, name, summary) and never sees this file, fault names, case ids or truth.

alert.summary: 业务请求需要只读调查

scoring.localisation_correct: A backend-verified claim (OBSERVATION_VERIFIED) references the injected root service as claim.service or claim.dependency.
scoring.mechanism_exact: A verified claim additionally matches the injected mechanism exactly (state==paused for pause cases; failure_code in the frozen family or state==exited for the stopped case).
scoring.unknown_not_correct: Reports without a verified claim score UNKNOWN, never correct.
scoring.wrong: A verified claim that references neither the root service nor its failure interface scores WRONG.
scoring.control_false_positive: The quiet control scores FALSE_POSITIVE if any claim is verified or confidence>0; a clean inconclusive finish scores CORRECT.
scoring.chance_baseline: Chance@1 is mean(1/len(plausible_root_services)) over fault cases; Lift = exact_localisation_accuracy / Chance@1.
scoring.scope_limited: Cases with scope_limited=true have a truth service the read-only tool scope cannot observe from the neutral alert; expected honest outcome is UNKNOWN without a wrong claim.

plausible_root_services_note: Frozen from the order-service claim surface (alert service + registered dependencies + observed registered upstream), not from any truth; identical for all order-service alert cases.
